data.content_ref: inline:The mechanism applies the overtime rate to all 47 hours, paying the first 40 hours at $27 instead of the stated $18 base rate. The problem specifies $18/hour for the first 40 hours and overtime (1.5x = $27) only for hours beyond 40. Correct pay: 40×$18 + 7×$27 = $720 + $189 = $909, not $1,269. The causal mechanism violates the wage structure by treating non-overtime hours as overtime.
